% !TeX program = lualatex
% The calibration deck: every frame type and list depth once, for a layout profile.

% project, or any other: tools/calibrate_font_profile.py swaps the \input below), then
% run tools/check_layout.py on the PDF and tools/calibrate_font_profile.py on the project.

\makeatletter
\def\input@path{{../}}
